    Lifted paths and row classes (Lemma A.2) #

    lem:twisted-trace-surjection (periodic-mesh-calculations.tex). Let π : ℤΔ → Q be a covering commuting with translation, with signed mesh coefficients. A path p of the doubled tree Δ̄ starting at v lifts to ℤΔ from τ X for any X = (v, t) (liftZ); the class of the image of the lift in coker D_m is phiD X p. Since contextual relations of Π(Δ) lift term by term with the same endpoints and heights, the linear extension phiL X of phiD X kills the ideal of Π(Δ) (phiL_eq_zero_of_mem).

                        theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.OrientedTree.phiD_rotate {D : Type v} (T : OrientedTree D) {V : Type v'} [Quiver V] [∀ (x y : V), Subsingleton (x ⟶ y)] {Q : TranslationQuiver V} (hQ : Q.IsStable) (π : T.ZVert ⥤q V) {k : Type u} [CommRing k] [(x : V) → Fintype ((y : V) × (y ⟶ x))] (c : MeshCoefficients k Q) [DecidableEq V] [(x y : V) → DecidableEq (x ⟶ y)] [DecidablePred fun (x : V) => x ∈ Q.nonprojective] [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] [DecidableRel T.orient] (hτ : ∀ (Y : T.ZVert), π.obj (T.ztau Y) = hQ.tauE (π.obj Y)) (σ : D ≃ D) (hσ : ∀ (a b : D), T.G.Adj (σ a) (σ b) ↔ T.G.Adj a b) (s : ℤ) (hσp : ∀ (v : D), T.par (σ v) = T.par v + ↑s) (hc : ScalarMeshCategory.OppositeOnMates c hQ) (hdeck : ∀ (Z : T.ZVert), π.obj ((T.zAct σ hσ s hσp).obj Z) = π.obj Z) {m : ℕ} (X : T.ZVert) {y : T.Dbl} (e : T.toDbl X.v ⟶ y) (q : Quiver.Path y ((T.dAct σ hσ).obj (T.toDbl X.v))) (hq : q.length = m) (hs : ↑m + 1 = 2 + s) :
                        T.phiD hQ π c m X (e.toPath.comp q) = T.phiD hQ π c m (T.raise X e) (q.comp ((T.dAct σ hσ).map e).toPath)

                        Twisted rotation of one arrow (proof of Lemma A.2): for a row path e q from v to σ v of length 2 + s, cutting after the initial arrow e and correcting its mesh mate gives [e q] = [q σ(e)], the latter lifted from one level higher.

                        theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.OrientedTree.phiD_rotate_path {D : Type v} (T : OrientedTree D) {V : Type v'} [Quiver V] [∀ (x y : V), Subsingleton (x ⟶ y)] {Q : TranslationQuiver V} (hQ : Q.IsStable) (π : T.ZVert ⥤q V) {k : Type u} [CommRing k] [(x : V) → Fintype ((y : V) × (y ⟶ x))] (c : MeshCoefficients k Q) [DecidableEq V] [(x y : V) → DecidableEq (x ⟶ y)] [DecidablePred fun (x : V) => x ∈ Q.nonprojective] [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] [DecidableRel T.orient] (hτ : ∀ (Y : T.ZVert), π.obj (T.ztau Y) = hQ.tauE (π.obj Y)) (σ : D ≃ D) (hσ : ∀ (a b : D), T.G.Adj (σ a) (σ b) ↔ T.G.Adj a b) (s : ℤ) (hσp : ∀ (v : D), T.par (σ v) = T.par v + ↑s) (hc : ScalarMeshCategory.OppositeOnMates c hQ) (hdeck : ∀ (Z : T.ZVert), π.obj ((T.zAct σ hσ s hσp).obj Z) = π.obj Z) {m : ℕ} (hs : ↑m + 1 = 2 + s) (X : T.ZVert) {z : T.Dbl} (U : Quiver.Path (T.toDbl X.v) z) (W : Quiver.Path z ((T.dAct σ hσ).obj (T.toDbl X.v))) :
                        U.length + W.length = m + 1 → T.phiD hQ π c m X (U.comp W) = T.phiD hQ π c m (T.liftEnd X U) (W.comp ((T.dAct σ hσ).mapPath U))

                        Twisted rotation of an initial segment: [U W] = [W σ(U)].

                        theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.OrientedTree.phiD_ztauInv {D : Type v} (T : OrientedTree D) {V : Type v'} [Quiver V] [∀ (x y : V), Subsingleton (x ⟶ y)] {Q : TranslationQuiver V} (hQ : Q.IsStable) (π : T.ZVert ⥤q V) {k : Type u} [CommRing k] [(x : V) → Fintype ((y : V) × (y ⟶ x))] (c : MeshCoefficients k Q) [DecidableEq V] [(x y : V) → DecidableEq (x ⟶ y)] [DecidablePred fun (x : V) => x ∈ Q.nonprojective] [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] [DecidableRel T.orient] (hτ : ∀ (Y : T.ZVert), π.obj (T.ztau Y) = hQ.tauE (π.obj Y)) (σ : D ≃ D) (hσ : ∀ (a b : D), T.G.Adj (σ a) (σ b) ↔ T.G.Adj a b) (s : ℤ) (hσp : ∀ (v : D), T.par (σ v) = T.par v + ↑s) (hc : ScalarMeshCategory.OppositeOnMates c hQ) (hdeck : ∀ (Z : T.ZVert), π.obj ((T.zAct σ hσ s hσp).obj Z) = π.obj Z) {m : ℕ} (hs : ↑m + 1 = 2 + s) (X : T.ZVert) (p : Quiver.Path (T.toDbl X.v) ((T.dAct σ hσ).obj (T.toDbl X.v))) (hp : p.length = m + 1) :
                        T.phiD hQ π c m X p = T.phiD hQ π c m (T.ztauInv X) p

                        The row class is independent of the repetition coordinate (proof of Lemma A.2: "applying this rotation d times identifies the row with its translate by τ").

                        theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.OrientedTree.phiD_height {D : Type v} (T : OrientedTree D) {V : Type v'} [Quiver V] [∀ (x y : V), Subsingleton (x ⟶ y)] {Q : TranslationQuiver V} (hQ : Q.IsStable) (π : T.ZVert ⥤q V) {k : Type u} [CommRing k] [(x : V) → Fintype ((y : V) × (y ⟶ x))] (c : MeshCoefficients k Q) [DecidableEq V] [(x y : V) → DecidableEq (x ⟶ y)] [DecidablePred fun (x : V) => x ∈ Q.nonprojective] [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] [DecidableRel T.orient] (hτ : ∀ (Y : T.ZVert), π.obj (T.ztau Y) = hQ.tauE (π.obj Y)) (σ : D ≃ D) (hσ : ∀ (a b : D), T.G.Adj (σ a) (σ b) ↔ T.G.Adj a b) (s : ℤ) (hσp : ∀ (v : D), T.par (σ v) = T.par v + ↑s) (hc : ScalarMeshCategory.OppositeOnMates c hQ) (hdeck : ∀ (Z : T.ZVert), π.obj ((T.zAct σ hσ s hσp).obj Z) = π.obj Z) {m : ℕ} (hs : ↑m + 1 = 2 + s) (X : T.ZVert) (p : Quiver.Path (T.toDbl X.v) ((T.dAct σ hσ).obj (T.toDbl X.v))) (hp : p.length = m + 1) (t' : ℤ) (ht' : ↑t' = T.par X.v) :
